claim.claim: The workflow automation market is $47B, growing at 23% CAGR
claim.delta: deck states $47B; Independent 2026 estimates put the whole workflow-automation category at $18-24B, not the $45-50B figures circulating in vendor-sponsored reports.

evidence.title: Workflow automation category sizing, independent composite 2026
evidence.snippet: Independent 2026 estimates put the whole workflow-automation category at $18-24B, not the $45-50B figures circulating in vendor-sponsored reports. The larger numbers are 2030 projections that roll legacy RPA seats, iPaaS spend and agent platforms into a single total. The slice a mid-market agentic tool can realistically serve is estimated at $3-5B today. Category growth is 16-19% annually; the 23%+ CAGR sometimes quoted is drawn from the RPA sub-segment during its 2019-2022 peak and has not been observed since.

interpretation: These are fixture claims and fixture evidence, not established market facts. Counts are computed by the findings layer; the assessment originates in mock analysis.
